blockingFindings.title: Missing explicit decision coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage for one of its allowed pass conditions.
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires a mandatory finding to pass only with exact repair evidence or an existing explicit allow/defer decision. The tests cover exact repair evidence but do not cover the explicit allow/defer decision path.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local test that exercises an existing explicit allow/defer decision allowing the mandatory finding through the gate.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage for one of its allowed pass conditions.

blockingFindings.title: Incomplete stale/unrelated/touched-only evidence rejection coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: The requirement coverage artifact marks R4 covered, but actual test files do not cover several required rejection classes.
blockingFindings.issue: R4 requires rejection of unrelated, stale, touched-only, fingerprint mismatch, tree mismatch, diff mismatch, and test-result mismatch evidence. The tests cover only the four mismatch cases, leaving unrelated, stale, and touched-only evidence untested.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local rejection tests for unrelated evidence, stale evidence, and touched-only evidence.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement coverage artifact marks R4 covered, but actual test files do not cover several required rejection classes.

blockingFindings.title: R7 test is a no-op
blockingFindings.rationale: This is a static anti-pattern that would pass without exercising production behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: The R7 test only asserts `true === true`, so it passes without exercising production behavior or the required shared/spec-local policy contracts.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Replace the no-op assertion with executable assertions that validate R7's required coverage contract, or remove the no-op and rely on meaningful tests explicitly mapped to R7.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is a static anti-pattern that would pass without exercising production behavior.

blockingFindings.title: Missing shared policy test coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding shared policy test coverage, and the coverage artifact contradicts the stated requirement.
blockingFindings.issue: R7 requires both spec-local and shared policy tests, but the coverage artifact lists only `tests/finding-disposition-policy.test.js` and no shared policy test file.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add the shared policy test file to the coverage artifact and ensure it contains executable coverage for the R1-R6 policy contracts, or adjust the requirement if shared policy tests are not actually required.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding shared policy test coverage, and the coverage artifact contradicts the stated requirement.
